newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila forms sugar council to strengthen industry.
newsitem.headline: Manila forms sugar council to strengthen industry.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos formed on Tuesday a multi-sector body to help prepare the local sugar industry to meet global competition, a senior official said.

Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero, emerging from a two-hour meeting with Ramos and local sugar planters and millers, told reporters the new sugar body will have representatives from the private sector.
The new sugar body will map up a blueprint to optimise local sugar production to enable it to compete with other sugar producing countries.

Sugar farmers and millers, hurt by the surge of cheap sugar imports mostly from Thailand in recent months, asked the government recently to maintain tariffs on imported Southeast Asian sugar to enable it to recover.
